topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I never meant to see it, didn't go looking or anything. Just stumbled upon this old notebook in the back of the closet, under a stack of unused blankets. Flipped it open, and there it was – a list, neat and tidy, with all the things they want to do. Half the items seem so superficial now, like they didn’t even try to think about it. Why keep this to themselves? It’s like they didn’t trust me enough to share, to be part of it. Now, I look at every ticked-off item and wonder if these moments were just for them, if I was just along for the ride.
